name: Dr. Rebecca Köhler
headline: Building teams, products, and companies in international tech ecosystems

positions.title: Head of Data Integrations and Partnerships
positions.description:
As the second employee at Maltego Technologies, I helped grow the company from its earliest days into a team of ~170 people, serving as a core member of the Senior Leadership Team. My focus has been on building and leading the cross-functional team behind Maltego's Data Marketplace, an ecosystem that connects investigators with the data they need to solve complex problems.

In 2023, we launched Maltego Data Pass, a new approach to data access that simplifies how investigators tap into powerful datasets, offering a unified solution in one place. This initiative redefined how our users approach data-driven investigations and has become a key part of Maltego’s value to its customers.

positions.title: Public Relations, Marketing & Product Management
positions.description:
I helped launch Telefónica Germany NEXT, a corporate spin-off focused on data analytics and IoT, as one of the first employees. Initially, I established the company’s marketing presence, including building the website and leading PR efforts crafting a public narrative that resulted in widespread media coverage highlighting our responsible approach to data analytics.

Later, I transitioned into a product management role, joining a new team dedicated to white-labeling a patented technology for anonymizing personally identifiable information (PII). This innovation balanced data privacy with delivering actionable insights, positioning the technology as a valuable tool for data-driven businesses in other industries.

positions.title: Project Manager (Corporate Strategy)
positions.description:
In this role, I drove high-impact, cross-functional strategic projects at the corporate level, addressing critical decisions that shaped the company’s long-term direction. My work focused on key areas such as network strategy, M&A, and post-merger integration, where I collaborated with senior stakeholders to deliver actionable outcomes and delivered presentations to our board.

My projects included strategic partnerships negotiations around founding a shared telecommunications network with a competitor, analyzing tradeoffs of investment in 3G vs. 4G networks, decision papers on monetization of 4G via premium or wholesale brands as well as M&A and PMI support.

positions.title: Management Team
positions.company: Center for Digital Technology and Management (CDTM)
positions.description: Co-ran a small organization between academia and practice offering an entrepreneurship education program, whose alumni raised 11% of German Venture Capital in 2013 and have been more likely to found unicorns than Stanford Graduates. This experience told me how to build teams and communities in innovative and high-performance environments and rooted me in a network of entrepreneurs, investors, and innovators shaping the German tech landscape.

positions.title: R&D Marketing
positions.description: Chance to immerse myself in India’s dynamic (business) culture: I advised Infosys R&D department about their own product marketing and effectiveness in reaching their internal stakeholders.

positions.title: Digitalization strategy for a publishing house
positions.description: Consulting internship around market expansion for a client from Switzerland and analyzing consumer spendings for entertainment.

positions.title: Market analysis, M&A
positions.description: Joined a small, dynamic project team for 2 months tasked with exploring the biotech market to uncover growth opportunities for Siemens. In this high-energy, fast-paced environment, we conducted comprehensive market mapping and identified strategic opportunities, including potential M&A targets, to align with Siemens’ long-term vision.

positions.title: Sales commercial offers | Supply chain processes
positions.description: Three months glimpse inside a pan-European company: learning how to sell a Military Aircraft (the Austrians bought the Eurofighter on my very first day!) and mapping out supply chain processes in the procurement department.

company.name: Maltego
company.tagline: Maltego is the world’s most used all-in-one intelligence platform for complex cyber investigations.
company.description:
Maltego is the world’s most used all-in-one investigation platform that turns complex data into actionable insights in minutes. Used by industry experts, law enforcement, and analysts at major organizations, it brings together all your data in one place, helping you uncover hidden connections with a suite of investigative tools. 

With Maltego, teams can conduct everything from preliminary OSINT investigations to in-depth link analysis of large datasets. The platform also makes it easy to spot threats in real time with social media monitoring and enables the capture of digital evidence before it is altered or removed.

Headquartered in Munich, Germany, Maltego has grown to over 100 employees and is trusted by 2,000+ government organizations and 4,000+ companies worldwide—including the FBI, INTERPOL, and leading tech and financial firms, including half of the Dow 30.
